definitions.explanation: Something that appears to exist but does not, or that existed only briefly and is now gone. Used for visual hallucinations, fleeting experiences, and things that seem dreamlike or unreal.
Used as a modifier (幻の) to describe something so rare or fleeting that it seems almost mythical or impossible to obtain.

examples.japanese: {幻|まぼろし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}る→見る：00283_miru⟧。
⟦あの→あの：00915_ano⟧{幸|しあわ}せな⟦{日々|ひび}→日々：04804_hibi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{幻|まぼろし}だった⟦の→の：09472_no⟧だろう⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
examples.english: Were those happy days just an illusion?

examples.japanese: ⟦{砂漠|さばく}→砂漠：09508_sabaku⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{旅人|たびびと}→旅人：12725_tabibito⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{見|み}た→見る：00283_miru⟧オアシス⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{幻|まぼろし}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧すぎなかった。
examples.english: The oasis the traveler saw in the desert was nothing but an illusion.
I got hold of a legendary rare sake.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{魚|さかな}→魚：00499_sakana⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{幻|まぼろし}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{魚|さかな}→魚：00499_sakana⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{呼|よ}ばれている→呼ぶ：00766_yobu⟧。
examples.english: This fish is called a legendary fish.

examples.japanese: ⟦{長年|ながねん}→長年：09684_naganen⟧{探|さが}し{求|もと}めて⟦いた→いる：00495_iru⟧{幻|まぼろし}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦レコード→レコード：02990_rekoodo⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{古|ふる}い→古い：00488_furui⟧⟦{中古|ちゅうこ}→中古：03479_chuuko⟧⟦レコード→レコード：02990_rekoodo⟧⟦{店|てん}→店：10011_ten⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧ようやく⟦{見|み}つかった→見つかる：01173_mitsukaru⟧。
examples.english: The legendary record I had been searching for over many years was finally found at an old secondhand record shop.

notes:
USAGE:
{幻|まぼろし} as a standalone noun means an illusion or vision — something that appears real but is not. As a modifier ({幻|まぼろし}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧), it describes something so rare, elusive, or short-lived that it takes on a mythical quality. This modifier usage is very common in food and drink writing ({幻|まぼろし}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{日本酒|にほんしゅ}→日本酒：12954_nihonshu⟧, {幻|まぼろし}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{食材|しょくざい}→食材：04940_shokuzai⟧) and in media ({幻|まぼろし}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{名作|めいさく}→名作：11869_meisaku⟧).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {幻|まぼろし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}る→見る：00283_miru⟧: to see a vision
- {幻|まぼろし}⟦のように→のように：30291_noyouni⟧⟦{消|き}える→消える：02520_kieru⟧: to vanish like a phantom
- {幻|まぼろし}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧～: legendary ~, phantom ~
- {幻|まぼろし}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{終|お}わる: to end as an illusion (to never materialize)
